stops.note: named the sacred wading bird associated with the god Thoth
adopted by Greek writers describing Egyptian religious life
carried into Latin natural histories such as Pliny's
entered English through Latin natural-history texts
stops.meaning: a long-legged wading bird related to herons and storks

current_meaning: A long-legged wading bird with a curved bill; several species are found worldwide, and it was sacred in ancient Egypt.
